sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and will be strong favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have managed just 4 points from 10 matches and are winless in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between two sides with recent losses on their records—Stafford are pursuing Sandbach's top spot with 20 points from 10 games. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall who sit fifth with 18 points; both teams are bidding to keep pace at the summit. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome struggling Wednesfield Community, with the visitors in poor form and the hosts looking to capitalize on recent wins. Bilston Town, sixth on 17 points, entertain Foley Meir in a mid-table clash. Barnton face Shawbury United, with the latter on a disastrous run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle of mid-table sides, both seeking consistency. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a tie between teams with similar records around mid-table. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town, two of the division's struggling sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, bottom of the league with just 2 points from 7 games. A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social entertain Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
